cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, has just commissioned Joshua son of Nun to lead the people after him (Numbers 27:22-23). Now the LORD gives Moses a command for the Israelites. They're to present His food offerings to Him, each one at its appointed time.

cards.question: The LORD wants His food offerings presented at the appointed time. What does He say they are to Him?

cards.text: First, every day: two unblemished year-old lambs, one in the morning and one at twilight, each with fine flour mixed with oil and a drink offering. The LORD calls it a regular burnt offering, established at Mount Sinai. Morning AND evening, friend. Every. Single. Day. I've got ONE oven light to switch off at night, and I still leave it on half the time.
Then comes the Sabbath day. Two unblemished year-old lambs go up, with a grain offering and a drink offering.

cards.question: On the Sabbath, the two Sabbath lambs take the place of the regular daily offering.

cards.text: At the beginning of every month, at each new moon, the list grows: two young bulls, one ram and seven lambs, all unblemished, each with its own grain offering and drink offering. On top of that comes one male goat as a sin offering, plus the regular daily offering. Friend, that's not a to-do list. That's a whole CALENDAR.

Now the yearly feasts. The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD's Passover. The next day, a seven-day feast begins, with unleavened bread eaten all seven days, and its first day is a sacred assembly with no regular work.
For the feast, Israel is to present two young bulls, one ram and seven lambs, all unblemished, with their grain offerings. One male goat goes with them as a sin offering.

cards.question: During the feast, one male goat is offered as a sin offering. What does the LORD say it's for?

cards.text: All of it comes on top of the regular morning burnt offering, with the same food offered each day for seven days. Seven mornings straight, and NOBODY hits snooze.

cards.question: The seven-day feast after Passover reaches its last day. What does Israel hold that day?

cards.text: Next is the day of firstfruits, during the Feast of Weeks, when Israel presents an offering of new grain to the LORD. It's a sacred assembly with no regular work, and the same lineup comes again, on top of the regular burnt offering: two young bulls, one ram, seven lambs and a male goat to make atonement.

cards.question: On the day of firstfruits, every animal offered must still be unblemished.

cards.text: Now the seventh month. Its first day is a sacred assembly with no regular work, and a day for Israel to sound the trumpets. Trumpets, friend! The loudest thing in my bakery is my oven timer, and it makes me jump EVERY time.
The offering: one young bull this time, one ram, seven lambs and a male goat as a sin offering to make atonement.

cards.question: Since the first day of the seventh month is also the start of a month, its offering replaces the monthly one.

cards.text: On the tenth day of this seventh month comes another sacred assembly, and the LORD tells the people to humble themselves.

cards.question: On the tenth day of the seventh month, what does the LORD say about work?

cards.text: Same offering as the first of the month: one young bull, one ram, seven lambs and a goat for a sin offering, on top of the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering.
Then on the fifteenth day comes another sacred assembly with no regular work, and a feast to the LORD that lasts seven days.

Day one, the numbers EXPLODE: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs and a goat for a sin offering, with their grain and drink offerings. Each day after that brings the same rams, lambs and goat, with one fewer bull each day, down to seven bulls on the seventh day. Thirteen BULLS, friend. I need a nap after ONE extra batch of cookies.

cards.question: When the seven-day feast in the seventh month is done, Israel goes right back to regular work the next day.

cards.text: The eighth day is a solemn assembly with no regular work, and its offering is one bull, one ram, seven lambs and a goat for a sin offering. Then the LORD wraps up the whole calendar.

cards.question: The LORD wraps up His instructions for the offerings. When does He say all of them are to be presented?

cards.text: And these all come in addition to their vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt, grain, drink or peace offerings.

cards.question: Moses tells the Israelites all of this, just as the LORD commanded him.
